correctness.rationale: A positive two-point certificate gives the universal upper bound. The proposed extremizer is globally nonnegative by an exact factorization whose residual quadratic has positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant. Equality forces two contacts and an interior derivative condition, which uniquely determine the free coefficients. The exact symbolic checker replays the cubic, contact, factorization, and discriminant identities.

value.rationale: The exact value of \(M(\{4,5\})\) is a natural invariant in the classical arbitrary-support Carathéodory–Fejér problem. It is the canonical adjacent two-harmonic support beyond the already checked lower supports, gives a nontrivial cubic sharp constant and unique extremizer, and provides a reusable exact benchmark for finite-support and positive-definite extremal problems rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
